description: This file contains the PHP class 'Setting' in the namespace Opencart.Admin.Model	ing, which manages configuration settings in an OpenCart admin system. It provides methods to get, set, update, and delete settings stored in a database.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Represents the settings model for managing configuration options within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specific store ID, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves settings for a specific code and store ID, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Inserts or updates settings for a given code and store ID, replacing existing entries for that code.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes settings associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings matching the specified code.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specific setting key for a given store ID.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates the value of a specific setting identified by code and key for a store ID.
